frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/listings/ListingGrid.tsx:61,76 — with an empty array and isLoading=false ListingGrid renders the hardcoded empty state `

No listings found

`. Net effect: a reality-server outage / 5xx / network failure on the public search page is indistinguishable from a legitimate zero-results search — the user sees 'No listings found' with no error message and no retry affordance, and crawlers may index the soft-empty page.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/listings/page.tsx:185 — `toggleFavorite.mutate({ listingId, isFavorite });` (useToggleFavorite) is fire-and-forget with no onError/onSettled; a failed favorite toggle silently no-ops with no user feedback and no optimistic-state rollback.

Fix: destructure `isError`/`error` from useListings and render a distinct error state (message + retry button) when isError is true, before falling through to the empty state; and pass an `onError` to `toggleFavorite.mutate` (or the useToggleFavorite hook) to surface/roll back a failed toggle.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/listings/LayoutSections.tsx:125 and :136 — both the placeholder branch and the real-component branch render each row with `key={section.type}` while mapping over `layout.sections`.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/lib/layout.ts:85-108 — `layout.sections` is a server-resolved list of `ResolvedSection` objects distinguished by `type` + `presentation` + `mode` + `props`; nothing enforces `type` uniqueness, and multiple sections of the same type (e.g. repeated 'custom'/'spacer'/'gallery' blocks differentiated by props) are a valid, expected payload. `getResolvedLayout` only filters non-object elements and clamps to MAX_SECTIONS — it does not dedupe or index types.

Impact: when a layout contains two sections of the same type, React sees duplicate sibling keys — it emits a dev warning and, on re-resolve/re-order of the sections list, reconciliation collides the duplicates: section-local state (e.g. a section's ErrorBoundary hasError, gallery index) can bleed between them or an update can be dropped. The `onClickCapture`/`data-layout-section={section.type}` preview bridge also targets ambiguously when two rows share the same type.
Fix: key on a stable unique id — prefer a server-provided section id if present, otherwise `key={`${section.type}-${index}`}` using the map index — at both LayoutSections.tsx:125 and :136.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/lib/kill-switch.ts:90-96 — localized maintenance copy ALREADY exists as `COPY[locale]` (used by the canonical middleware kill-switch path, src/middleware.ts:37-49, which emits a real 503). The SSR fallback branch in layout.tsx duplicates the maintenance UI but hardcodes English instead of reusing that COPY table, so a Slovak/Czech/German user hitting the rare edge-fetch-failed-but-SSR-succeeded fallback gets English.

Fix: reuse the `kill-switch.ts` `COPY` strings (or the shared normalizeKillSwitchLocale + COPY lookup) keyed by `locale` in the layout.tsx:154-160 fallback, so the defense-in-depth path matches the localized middleware path.
